scope: Finite exact-integer/transcribed-generator model on exposed 807 inputs, checksum-anchored to actual Lean output. No Lean proof, native Float32 execution, new timing, private prevalence, future confirmation or gain claim.
loading: Cached AST function definitions only; R mains/imports never executed; no bytecode files.
native_domain_model: Output nonNaN uses exact oracle output classification, corresponding to the source-derived canonical-native model, not measured hardware.
case_count_scope: 156 total output cases = 152 timed scoring cases + 4 raw checksum cases. Scalars contain 43 add and 43 mul cases, including one raw per operation.
pass_counting: One original checksum pass per scalar case (seed0). Timed cases repeat the same operand domain for inner3; these counts are not time shares.
checksum_scope: 86 rolling 32-bit checksums checked against four repeated actual records, not per-output Lean comparison or independent confirmation. Equality does not replace a proof.

counter_definitions.finite_pairs: Both raw input exponents differ from255.
counter_definitions.nonfinite_pairs: At least one raw input exponent equals255.
counter_definitions.zero_pairs: At least one signed-zero input word.
counter_definitions.exp_sum_lt_128_pairs: Input attribute on both operations; only mul actually dispatches on this condition.
counter_definitions.mul_low_zero_hits: Actual outer mul low path and at least one signed-zero operand.
counter_definitions.native_mul_old_reject_finite_guard_pairs: exSum>=128 and at least one input NaN/Inf; counts rejected pairs, not predicate invocations.
counter_definitions.native_mul_new_inf_accept_old_rejected_p: Old nativeMul input-finite guard rejects, but exact/canonical-native output is Inf and a nonNaN output guard would accept.

full60f_time_ceiling.note: Each cell is an upper bound shared by all its cases. Counts do not allocate any fraction of that time to an opportunity.

mul_low_zero_hits.note: Entire affected-cell exposure ceiling, not the time used by counted pairs.

native_mul_old_reject_finite_guard_pairs.note: Entire affected-cell exposure ceiling, not the time used by counted pairs.

native_mul_new_inf_accept_old_rejected_p.note: Entire affected-cell exposure ceiling, not the time used by counted pairs.

output_nan.note: Entire affected-cell exposure ceiling, not the time used by counted pairs.
